excerpts.content: Can I get some help here to set up CI in my clone or locally so that I don't run in vain on the main repo?

excerpts.content: cc <@543900561460822016> <@792822129019584562> you guys are in different timezones and may know this 😄

excerpts.author: samwilsn
excerpts.content: You can run locally if you'd like

excerpts.author: samwilsn
excerpts.content:
Something like:

```bash
cargo install --git https://github.com/ethereum/eipw.git
cd ~/ERCS/
eipw --config ./config/eipw.toml ERCS/erc-1155.md
```

Ohh no this is different! thanks a lot <@689161464829050960>, I ended up running with 
```
cd EIPs
cargo install eipw
~/.cargo/bin/eipw ./EIPS/eip-epbs.md
```
